```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
source(here::here("scripts", "load-data.R"))

diverging_bar_chart <- function(data, variable, title) {
  data |>
    count(response = {{ variable }}) |>
    filter(!is.na(response)) |>
    mutate(signed_n = if_else(response %in% c("Strongly disagree",
                                              "Disagree",
                                              "Slightly disagree"), -n, n),
           response = factor(response, levels = c("Strongly disagree",
                                                  "Disagree",
                                                  "Slightly disagree",
                                                  "Slightly agree",
                                                  "Agree",
                                                  "Strongly agree"),
                             labels = c("Strongly Disagree",
                                        "Disagree",
                                        "Slightly Disagree",
                                        "Slightly Agree",
                                        "Agree",
                                        "Strongly Agree"))) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = "", y = signed_n, fill = response)) +
    geom_col(data = \(data) filter(data, signed_n < 0),
             width = 0.32) +
    geom_col(data = \(data) filter(data, signed_n > 0),
             width = 0.32,
             position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
    geom_text(data = \(data) filter(data, signed_n < 0),
              aes(label = n),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
              color = "white",
              fontface = "bold",
              size = 4) +
    geom_text(data = \(data) filter(data, signed_n > 0),
              aes(label = n),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5, reverse = TRUE),
              color = "white",
              fontface = "bold",
              size = 4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.45) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = abs) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Strongly Disagree" = "#b33b00",
      "Disagree" = "#e57200",
      "Slightly Disagree" = "#c98b5a",
      "Slightly Agree" = "#7f8fa1",
      "Agree" = "#2c7fb8",
      "Strongly Agree" = "#00508c")) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "<span style='color:#b33b00'><b>Strongly Disagree</b></span> | ",
        "<span style='color:#e57200'><b>Disagree</b></span> | ",
        "<span style='color:#c98b5a'><b>Slightly Disagree</b></span> | ",
        "<span style='color:#7f8fa1'><b>Slightly Agree</b></span> | ",
        "<span style='color:#2c7fb8'><b>Agree</b></span> | ",
        "<span style='color:#00508c'><b>Strongly Agree</b></span>"),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_markdown(hjust = 0,
                                           margin = margin(t = 8, b = 14),
                                           size = 10),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

bar_chart <- function(data, variable, title, levels, labels, colors) {
  data |>
    count(response = {{ variable }}) |>
    filter(!is.na(response)) |>
    mutate(response = str_squish(str_replace_all(response, "\\u00a0", " ")),
           response = factor(response, levels = levels, labels = labels)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = response, y = n, fill = response)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n),
              vjust = -0.4,
              color = "gray20",
              fontface = "bold",
              size = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of Students",
      fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6)),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

summary_likert_chart <- function(data, items, title) {
  response_levels <- c("Strongly disagree",
                       "Disagree",
                       "Slightly disagree",
                       "Slightly agree",
                       "Agree",
                       "Strongly agree")
  response_labels <- c("Strongly Dis.",
                       "Disagree",
                       "Slightly Dis.",
                       "Slightly Ag.",
                       "Agree",
                       "Strongly Ag.")
  response_colors <- c(
    "Strongly Dis." = "#b33b00",
    "Disagree" = "#e57200",
    "Slightly Dis." = "#c98b5a",
    "Slightly Ag." = "#7f8fa1",
    "Agree" = "#2c7fb8",
    "Strongly Ag." = "#00508c")

  item_positions <- tibble(
    item = names(items),
    item_label = unname(items),
    item_position = rev(seq_along(items)))

  plot_data <- data |>
    select(all_of(names(items))) |>
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "item", values_to = "response") |>
    mutate(response = str_squish(str_replace_all(response, "\\u00a0", " "))) |>
    filter(!is.na(response), response %in% response_levels) |>
    count(item, response) |>
    complete(item = names(items), response = response_levels, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
    mutate(
      response = factor(response,
                        levels = response_levels,
                        labels = response_labels),
      side = if_else(response %in% response_labels[1:3], "negative", "positive"),
      stack_order = case_when(
        response == "Slightly Dis." ~ 1,
        response == "Disagree" ~ 2,
        response == "Strongly Dis." ~ 3,
        response == "Slightly Ag." ~ 1,
        response == "Agree" ~ 2,
        response == "Strongly Ag." ~ 3
      )) |>
    arrange(item, side, stack_order) |>
    group_by(item, side) |>
    mutate(
      cumulative_n = cumsum(n),
      previous_n = lag(cumulative_n, default = 0),
      xmin = if_else(side == "positive", previous_n, -cumulative_n),
      xmax = if_else(side == "positive", cumulative_n, -previous_n),
      label = if_else(n >= 3, as.character(n), "")
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    left_join(item_positions, by = "item")

  horizontal_extent <- max(abs(c(plot_data$xmin, plot_data$xmax)))

  plot_data |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = xmin,
                  xmax = xmax,
                  ymin = item_position - 0.32,
                  ymax = item_position + 0.32,
                  fill = response)) +
    geom_text(aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
                  y = item_position,
                  label = label),
              color = "white",
              fontface = "bold",
              size = 4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.45) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-horizontal_extent, horizontal_extent),
                       labels = abs,
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = item_positions$item_position,
                       labels = str_wrap(item_positions$item_label, width = 42),
                       expand = expansion(add = 0.65)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = response_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "<span style='color:#b33b00'><b>Strongly Dis.</b></span> | ",
        "<span style='color:#e57200'><b>Disagree</b></span> | ",
        "<span style='color:#c98b5a'><b>Slightly Dis.</b></span> | ",
        "<span style='color:#7f8fa1'><b>Slightly Ag.</b></span> | ",
        "<span style='color:#2c7fb8'><b>Agree</b></span> | ",
        "<span style='color:#00508c'><b>Strongly Ag.</b></span>"),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_markdown(hjust = 0,
                                       margin = margin(t = 8, b = 14),
                                       size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 8)),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 18, b = 8, l = 8))
}
```

## Summary Likert visualizations

```{r}
#| label: fig-practitioner-likert-summary
#| fig-cap: "Practitioner perceptions of the Designed for Impact Tool. Bars show the number of responses in each Likert category; the centered boundary separates Slightly Disagree from Slightly Agree."
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 8
#| out-width: 100%
summary_likert_chart(
  practitioner,
  c(
    strengthens_statistician_role = "Using formal tool strengthens statisticians' role as collaborators.",
    overall_useful = "DIT is useful for consulting practice.",
    would_use_for_teaching = "Would use DIT to teach junior consultants.",
    would_recommend = "Would recommend DIT to other practitioners.",
    prompts_overlooked_discussions = "DIT prompts overlooked discussions."
  ),
  "Practitioner Perceptions of the Designed for Impact Tool"
)
```
